defects.description: Two internal senders emit different versions of the same webhook payload for the same endpoint: the checkout path sends v2 (with currency), the legacy import path still sends v1 (without it).
The legacy import path was never migrated when the webhook contract was upgraded to v2 -- this is the structural root cause, not a one-off bug in the import path.

The consumer trusts the v2 doc unconditionally (payload.currency.toUpperCase() with no null check), so the version gap surfaces only for orders from the one un-migrated source, making it look data-dependent/intermittent rather than a structural version mismatch.
